items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: Clarence Williams, he was the man he was here then. And we had those pictures made to play on the Orphan Circa. By some means Pierone and Williams didn't agree. And Clarence Williams went off and left us there.

ctx.x: I was going to ask about this picture over here that you showed us the other day. With this group with Pierone and Benton and St. Cyr. I have a copy of this picture. But you said they were going to go on the road for some reason.

This was when the district first closed. And Clarence Williams, he was the man he was here then. And we had those pictures made to play on the Orphan Circa. By some means Pierone and Williams didn't agree. And Clarence Williams went off and left us there. But Pierone was the cause. We didn't get this job. We would have been the first colored band. See, you know what I said. That was 40 years ago. See. Alarm for Dixie. Then.
Before the original Dixie Land left here.
